title: BoundaryEvo: Data-Model Co-Evolution at the Capability Boundary for Long-Chain Reasoning Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distilling long-chain reasoning trajectories from large teacher models provides an effective way to improve the reasoning ability of small language models. However, existing methods typically select a fixed training set before distillation, overlooking that the usefulness of a reasoning example changes as the student evolves. This mismatch becomes especially costly when only a small number of teacher trajectories can be used for training. Besides, examples already mastered provide little new supervision, while examples far beyond the capability of student may be difficult to learn from. Training data should therefore adapt as model capability evolves, yet reliable data selection is difficult when the student is initially weak. To address these challenges, our key idea is to first establish the basic reasoning capability and then adapt the training data to the evolving capability boundary of the student. translated_title: BoundaryEvo：面向长链推理蒸馏的能力边界处数据-模型协同演化
translated_abstract: 从大型教师模型中蒸馏长链推理轨迹是提升小型语言模型推理能力的有效方法。然而，现有方法通常在蒸馏前选取固定的训练集，忽略了推理样本的有用性会随着学生模型的演进而变化这一事实。当只能使用少量教师轨迹进行训练时，这种不匹配的代价尤为显著。此外，学生模型已经掌握的样本几乎不提供新的监督信号，而远超学生能力范围的样本则可能难以从中学习。因此，训练数据应当随模型能力的演化而自适应调整，但当学生模型初始能力较弱时，可靠的数据选择十分困难。为应对这些挑战，我们的核心思想是首先建立基础推理能力，然后使训练数据适配学生模型不断演化的能力边界。我们提出BoundaryEvo，一个两阶段……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: BoundaryEvo提出一种两阶段框架，先帮助学生模型建立基础推理能力，再使训练数据随学生模型的能力边界协同演化，从而在仅有少量教师轨迹的条件下高效提升小模型的长链推理能力。
en_tdlr: BoundaryEvo proposes a two-stage framework that first establishes basic reasoning capability and then co-evolves the training data with the student's evolving capability boundary, enabling efficient long-chain reasoning distillation when only a small number of teacher trajectories are available.
